_comment: Owner-reviewed corrections, applied over every classifier and the judge (see final.js). Each one states why. Use for a classification that is wrong on the evidence, not to settle taste.

level.reason: This root holds only White's quiet third moves after 2...Nc6; 3.d4 and 3.Bb5 are their own roots. Both classifiers judged it from evidence about the Open Sicilian with ...Nc6, which belongs to those other roots.

plans.reason: The unsourced brief read the rare Reuter Gambit (3.Nf3 dxe4 4.Ng5) as the main line, and the judge (2026-10-05) ruled every axis back to the 2...d5 3.e5 Advance structure. The brief's plans (lead in development first) came from the same misreading; these are the Advance French plans with f4 already in.
